ei.subject: 공통영어1 미래엔(김성연)
ei.title: The Power of Friendliness: Soft but Strong

fullPassage: In our competitive society, many people believe that only the biggest or the strongest can survive and thrive. However, I propose an alternative view: kindness is the key to success. Isn’t that a comforting thought? We can use the power of our natural kindness to communicate and cooperate with different individuals. We can all benefit from this instead of trying to be better than others. I’d like to end this talk with a message. Think of our society as a bouquet. Just as each flower adds to the beauty when it __________ with the others, each person can contribute to a more beautiful world when they cooperate. By being kind and working together, we can truly flourish. Thank you for your attention.

questions.passage: I’ll give you another example of how friendliness is related to survival. Dr. Hare and his colleagues designed an experiment with chimpanzees and bonobos. Although the two are (A) similar, they are different in nature. To study their (B) behavior, Dr. Hare’s team set up a device which required two individuals to pull both ends of a rope at the same time in order to access food on a board. The bonobos, on the other hand, got along much better than the chimpanzees. This research shows that bonobos have a cooperative and friendly nature. Experts suggest that their nature has helped their species survive. Without these characteristics, they could have faced (C).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 침팬지와 보노보는 유전적으로(genetically) 비슷하고, 협력적(cooperative) 행동을 연구했으며, 이런 특성이 없었다면 멸종(extinction)에 직면했을 것이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① genetically — cooperative — extinction: 원문과 일치
❌ ② physically: 유전적이 아닌 신체적
❌ ③ competitive: cooperative의 반의어
❌ ④ evolution: extinction의 반대 개념
❌ ⑤ 모두 부적절
det.tip: genetically(유전적으로) ↔ physically(신체적으로), cooperative(협력적) ↔ competitive(경쟁적), extinction(멸종) ↔ evolution(진화)

questions.passage: Neanderthals existed together with Homo sapiens until about 40,000 years ago, and they were known to be intelligent and (A) superior to Homo sapiens. Neanderthals were able to make tools and fire and had strong bodies with well-developed muscles and broad shoulders. Despite these attributes, however, it was Homo sapiens who ultimately survived and thrived. One possible explanation is that our ancestors lived in larger communities that (B) cooperation and the free exchange of knowledge, while Neanderthals tended to live in smaller groups. These social differences may have given Homo sapiens a (C) advantage over Neanderthals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 네안데르탈인은 신체적으로(physically) 우월했고, 호모 사피엔스의 공동체는 협력을 촉진(promoted)했으며, 이것이 경쟁적(competitive) 이점을 주었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① physically — promoted — competitive: 원문과 일치
❌ ② mentally: 본문은 physically
❌ ③ hindered(방해): promoted의 반의어
❌ ④ physical advantage: competitive advantage가 원문
❌ ⑤ 모두 부적절
det.tip: promoted(촉진) ↔ hindered(방해), competitive(경쟁적) ↔ physical(신체적) — 문맥에서 구분

questions.passage: It’s good to see you, everyone! I’m Dr. Edward Wilson, an ①<u>evolutionary</u> biologist. Thank you for inviting me here today. On my way, I had trouble ②<u>locating</u> this room. Luckily, a ③<u>hostile</u> student came up to me and walked me here. It’s ④<u>fascinating</u> how, in situations like this, we want to help someone in ⑤<u>need</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 "a friendly student"(친절한 학생). ③ hostile(적대적인)은 friendly의 반의어로 문맥에 부적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ hostile(적대적인): 원문 friendly → 다가와서 데려다주는 친절한 학생
✅ ① evolutionary(진화의): 원문 일치
✅ ② locating(찾는): 원문 일치
✅ ④ fascinating(매력적인): 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ need(필요): 원문 일치
det.tip: friendly(친절한) ↔ hostile(적대적인) — 문맥: 학생이 다가와 데려다줌 → 친절한 행동

questions.passage: In our ①<u>competitive</u> society, many people believe that only the biggest or the strongest can survive and thrive. However, I propose an ②<u>alternative</u> view: kindness is the key to success. Isn’t that a ③<u>comforting</u> thought? We can use the power of our natural kindness to ④<u>isolate</u> and cooperate with different individuals. We can all ⑤<u>benefit</u> from this instead of trying to be better than others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 "to communicate and cooperate"(소통하고 협력하다). ④ isolate(고립시키다)는 communicate의 반의어로 부적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ isolate(고립시키다): 원문 communicate → cooperate와 병렬로 소통하다
✅ ① competitive(경쟁적인): 원문 일치
✅ ② alternative(대안적인): 원문 일치
✅ ③ comforting(위안이 되는): 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ benefit(이익을 얻다): 원문 일치
det.tip: communicate(소통하다) ↔ isolate(고립시키다) — cooperate와 병렬이므로 소통/협력 맥락

questions.passage: On my way, I had trouble <u>locating</u> this room.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 locating의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: locating = 위치를 찾다, finding = 찾다 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ② finding(찾다): locating의 동의어
❌ ① building(짓다): 다른 의미
❌ ③ leaving(떠나다): 반대 방향
❌ ④ cleaning(청소하다): 무관
det.tip: locate = find = 찾다, 위치를 알아내다

questions.passage: Despite these attributes, however, it was Homo sapiens who ultimately survived and <u>thrived</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 thrived의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: thrived = 번성했다, flourished = 번영했다 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ③ flourished(번영했다): thrived의 동의어
❌ ① declined(쇠퇴했다): 반의어
❌ ② struggled(고군분투했다): 번성과 다름
❌ ④ disappeared(사라졌다): 반의어
det.tip: thrive = flourish = prosper = 번성하다, 번영하다

questions.passage: Dr. Hare <u>concluded</u> that the dogs’ ability to read human gestures allowed them to perform better than the wolves.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 concluded의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: concluded = 결론지었다, determined = 판단했다/결정했다 → 유사 의미
det.analysis:
✅ ④ determined(판단했다): concluded의 동의어
❌ ① assumed(가정했다): 근거 없는 추정
❌ ② questioned(의문을 제기했다): 반대
❌ ③ denied(부정했다): 반의어
det.tip: conclude = determine = decide = 결론짓다, 판단하다

questions.passage: Those that acted <u>friendly</u> toward humans evolved into dogs.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 friendly의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: friendly = 친절한 ↔ hostile = 적대적인
det.analysis:
❌ ④ hostile(적대적인): friendly의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① kind(친절한): 동의어
✅ ② warm(따뜻한): 유사어
✅ ③ gentle(온화한): 유사어
det.tip: friendly = kind = warm = gentle ↔ hostile = unfriendly = aggressive

questions.passage: Our ancestors lived in larger communities that <u>promoted</u> cooperation and the free exchange of knowledge.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 promoted의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: promoted = 촉진했다 ↔ hindered = 방해했다
det.analysis:
❌ ③ hindered(방해했다): promoted의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① encouraged(장려했다): 동의어
✅ ② advanced(발전시켰다): 유사어
✅ ④ facilitated(용이하게 했다): 동의어
det.tip: promote = encourage = facilitate = advance ↔ hinder = impede = obstruct

questions.passage: It’s good to see you, everyone! I’m Dr. Edward Wilson, an evolutionary biologist. Thank you for inviting me here today. On my way, I had trouble __________ this room. Luckily, a friendly student came up to me and walked me here.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 오는 길에 이 장소를 찾는 데(locating) 어려움을 겪었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② locating(찾는): "had trouble + ~ing" + 친절한 학생이 데려다줌 → 장소를 찾는 데 어려움
❌ ① decorating(장식하는): 문맥과 무관
❌ ③ cleaning(청소하는): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ renovating(개조하는): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: have trouble ~ing = ~하는 데 어려움을 겪다

questions.passage: This research shows that bonobos have a cooperative and friendly nature. Experts suggest that their nature has helped their species __________. Without these characteristics, they could have faced extinction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 보노보의 협력적 본성이 종의 생존(survive)에 도움이 되었다. 이 특성이 없었다면 멸종에 직면했을 것.
det.analysis:
✅ ② survive(생존하다): extinction(멸종)의 반대 맥락 → 생존에 도움
❌ ① compete(경쟁하다): 협력 맥락과 불일치
❌ ③ migrate(이주하다): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ dominate(지배하다): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: survive ↔ face extinction: 생존하다 ↔ 멸종에 직면하다 — 대비 관계로 단서 파악

questions.passage: One possible explanation is that our ancestors lived in larger communities that promoted cooperation and the free exchange of knowledge, while Neanderthals tended to live in smaller groups. These social differences may have given Homo sapiens a competitive __________ over Neanderthals, allowing them to adapt to an ever-changing environment.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사회적 차이가 호모 사피엔스에게 경쟁적 이점(advantage)을 주어 적응을 가능하게 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② advantage(이점): "allowing them to adapt" → 긍정적 결과를 가져온 이점
❌ ① disadvantage(불이점): 적응 성공과 모순
❌ ③ similarity(유사성): 문맥상 부적절
❌ ④ independence(독립): 문맥상 부적절
det.tip: competitive advantage = 경쟁적 우위/이점 — "allowing + 긍정적 결과"가 핵심 단서

questions.passage: The responsive behavior of dogs also <u>caught</u> the attention of an evolutionary anthropologist, Brian Hare.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 caught의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: caught the attention = 관심을 끌었다
det.analysis:
✅ ② 끌었다: catch one’s attention = 관심을 끌다
❌ ① 잡았다: catch a ball
❌ ③ 감염되었다: catch a cold
❌ ④ 탔다: catch a bus
det.tip: catch: 잡다 | catch attention = 관심을 끌다 | catch a cold = 감기에 걸리다 | catch a bus = 버스를 타다

questions.passage: However, I <u>propose</u> an alternative view: kindness is the key to success.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 propose의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: propose an alternative view = 대안적 견해를 제안하다
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 견해를 제안하다: propose + view/idea = 의견을 제시하다
❌ ① 청혼하다: propose (to someone)
❌ ② 건배를 제안하다: propose a toast
❌ ④ 법안을 제출하다: propose a bill
det.tip: propose: 제안하다 | propose a view = 견해 제시 | propose to = 청혼 | propose a toast = 건배 제의

questions.passage: In our competitive society, many people believe that only the biggest or the strongest can survive and thrive. However, I propose an alternative view: kindness is the key to success. Isn’t that a comforting thought? We can use the power of our natural kindness to communicate and cooperate with different individuals. We can all benefit from this instead of trying to be better than others. I’d like to end this talk with a message. Think of our society as a bouquet. Just as each flower adds to the beauty when it __________ with the others, each person can contribute to a more beautiful world when they cooperate. By being kind and working together, we can truly flourish. Thank you for your attention.
questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"the quality of being kind, warm, and pleasant to others"

det.korean: '다른 사람에게 친절하고, 따뜻하며, 기분 좋은 성질' → friendliness(다정함, 친절함)
det.analysis:
✅ ② friendliness: 영영 정의와 정확히 일치
❌ ① hostility(적대감): 반의어
❌ ③ intelligence(지능): 다른 의미
❌ ④ superiority(우월함): 다른 의미
det.tip: friendliness = kind + warm + pleasant → 친절함, 다정함

questions.passage: In our competitive society, many people believe that only the biggest or the strongest can survive and thrive. However, I propose an alternative view: kindness is the key to success. Isn’t that a comforting thought? We can use the power of our natural kindness to communicate and cooperate with different individuals. We can all benefit from this instead of trying to be better than others. I’d like to end this talk with a message. Think of our society as a bouquet. Just as each flower adds to the beauty when it __________ with the others, each person can contribute to a more beautiful world when they cooperate. By being kind and working together, we can truly flourish. Thank you for your attention.
questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"a person or animal that lived a very long time ago and is related to a modern person or animal"

det.korean: '아주 오래전에 살았고 현대의 사람이나 동물과 관련된 사람이나 동물' → ancestor(조상)
det.analysis:
✅ ② ancestor(조상): 영영 정의와 일치
❌ ① descendant(후손): 반대 방향 (현대→과거가 아닌 과거→현대)
❌ ③ companion(동반자): 다른 의미
❌ ④ colleague(동료): 다른 의미
det.tip: ancestor(조상) ↔ descendant(후손) — "lived a very long time ago"가 핵심 단서

questions.passage: The __________ (respond) behavior of dogs also caught the attention of an evolutionary anthropologist, Brian Hare. He conducted an experiment to see how dogs would respond to human gestures compared to wolves, who share the same common ancestor.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: respond(동사) → responsive(형용사): 명사 behavior를 수식하는 형용사 필요. "반응하는, 반응을 잘 보이는"
det.analysis:
respond(동사) → responsive(형용사)
빈칸 뒤 behavior(명사)를 수식하는 형용사가 필요
responsive behavior = 반응적 행동
det.tip: respond → responsive / act → active / create → creative — 동사 → -ive 형용사 변환

questions.passage: Furthermore, Dr. Hare suggested that the friendly nature of dogs probably provided them with a __________ (survive) advantage that allowed their population to grow larger than that of wolves.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: survive(동사) → survival(명사): 명사 advantage 앞에서 복합명사를 구성. "생존의 이점"
det.analysis:
survive(동사) → survival(명사)
survival advantage = 생존의 이점 (복합명사 구조)
det.tip: survive → survival / arrive → arrival / approve → approval — 동사 → -al 명사 변환

questions.passage: In our competitive society, many people believe that only the biggest or the strongest can survive and thrive. However, I propose an alternative view: kindness is the key to success. Isn’t that a comforting thought? We can use the power of our natural kindness to communicate and cooperate with different individuals. We can all benefit from this instead of trying to be better than others. I’d like to end this talk with a message. Think of our society as a bouquet. Just as each flower adds to the beauty when it __________ with the others, each person can contribute to a more beautiful world when they cooperate. By being kind and working together, we can truly flourish. Thank you for your attention.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 각각의 꽃이 나머지 꽃들과 조화를 이룰(harmonizes) 때 아름다움을 더해준다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ harmonizes(조화를 이루다): "adds to the beauty" + 꽃다발 비유 → 조화
❌ ① competes(경쟁하다): 꽃다발 비유와 모순
❌ ② clashes(충돌하다): 반의어
❌ ④ contrasts(대조되다): 조화와 반대
❌ ⑤ struggles(고군분투하다): 문맥과 불일치
det.tip: harmonize = 조화를 이루다 ↔ clash/contrast = 충돌하다/대비되다 — 꽃다발 비유의 핵심

questions.passage: I’d like to end this talk with a message. Think of our society as a bouquet. Just as each flower adds to the beauty when it harmonizes with the others, each person can contribute to a more beautiful world when they cooperate. By being kind and working together, we can truly __________. Thank you for your attention.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 친절하고 함께 일함으로써, 우리는 진정으로 번창(flourish)할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② flourish(번창하다): "being kind and working together" → 긍정적 결과 = 번창
❌ ① decline(쇠퇴하다): 반의어
❌ ③ struggle(고군분투하다): 부정적
❌ ④ compete(경쟁하다): kindness 주제와 불일치
❌ ⑤ perish(소멸하다): 반의어
det.tip: flourish = thrive = prosper = 번창하다 — "being kind + working together"가 긍정적 결과의 단서
